newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish October T-bill auction draws mixed rates.
newsitem.headline: Danish October T-bill auction draws mixed rates.

text.p: Denmark's central bank said on Wednesday its monthly treasury bill auction resulted in minimum rates of 3.60 percent for the five-month and 3.66 percent for the eight-month series.
One month ago the five-month series, then with a maturity of six months, yielded 3.60 percent, with the eight-month series, at that time with nine-month maturity, yielding 3.70 percent.

The central bank said it sold 1.43 billion crowns worth of the five-month series, 3.03 billion crowns worth of the eight-month series, giving a total of 4.46 billion crowns for both series. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33-969652
